annotation.title_clean: UN Regulation No 152 – Uniform provisions concerning the approval of motor vehicles with regard to the Advanced Emergency Braking System (AEBS) for M1 and N1 vehicles
annotation.title_en: UN Regulation No 152 – Uniform provisions concerning the approval of motor vehicles with regard to the Advanced Emergency Braking System (AEBS) for M1 and N1 vehicles
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UNECE (World Forum for Harmonization of Vehicle Regulations, WP.29); published in the Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 360/66
annotation.summary_en: UN Regulation No 152 sets uniform type-approval requirements for Advanced Emergency Braking Systems in M1 and N1 vehicles. It specifies performance, warnings, driver override, test procedures with car and pedestrian targets, conformity of production, and electronic-system safety documentation and verification (Annex 3).
key_provisions_or_claims: AEBS must detect imminent forward collisions with vehicles and pedestrians, warn the driver and brake at least 5.0 m/s2.
Driver can interrupt or override the system; manual deactivation requires two deliberate actions and resets each ignition cycle.
Prescribed test procedures with soft targets (ISO 19206) and maximum impact speed tables.
Type approval, approval marks, conformity of production checks and penalties under the 1958 Agreement.
Annex 3 requires safety concept, FMEA/FTA hazard analysis and fault verification for electronic control systems.
